name: comp-595
blurb: Collaboration navbar with back button, header title, and action buttons.
description: Header with back button, page title, history/comments/add-user buttons, and avatar stack showing online collaborators.
use_when: Collaborative editors or team workspaces where seeing active collaborators is important.
avoid_when: Single-user apps; presence data adds visual noise.
a11y: Back button labeled. Title is semantic. Avatar images have alt text. Action buttons labeled.
